meta_title: NYCU LIFE | Your campus digital companion
meta_description: NYCU LIFE is a campus digital companion that brings campus buses, course search, and place information into one place to make campus life easier.
hero_lede: We take the campus routines students repeat every day and turn them into a set of digital services that read more clearly and feel smoother to use.
hero_marquee: Live bus times · Course search · Place context · Open source · Built by students
hero_image_caption: Built for the students of NYCU
services_lede: Each service solves a different task, yet they should all feel like the same campus front door. Scroll down to bring each one into focus.
service_bus_summary: Shuttles, city buses, coaches, and campus routes brought into one readable flow.
service_bus_blurb: A native app with live arrival times and route maps, so moving between campuses reads like one trip instead of several unrelated systems.
service_bus_feature_2: Shuttles, city buses, and coaches in one place
service_courses_summary: Course discovery should help you shape a whole semester, not just search a table.
service_courses_blurb: Powerful search and advanced filters, plus favorites, schedule planning, and enrollment stats make building a timetable clear, flexible, and easy to compare.
service_courses_feature_1: Search and advanced filters reduce guesswork
service_places_summary: Start with classrooms and course locations, then grow a clearer sense of campus.
service_places_blurb: Room lookup and course locations make the next move clearer. We honestly call it place context, not a complete map product.
service_places_feature_3: A growing sense of campus direction
team_title: Built by students, made for students
team_lede: NYCU LIFE is an open-source project maintained by a group of students who believe campus life can be better, working on it in their spare time.
member_lead_intro: Convinced that good tools can take a little friction out of campus life.
member_design_intro: Distills complex campus information into interfaces that read and flow well.
member_backend_intro: Keeping live data flowing steadily is the foundation of a service worth trusting.
join_lede: Whether you code, design, write docs, or simply have ideas to make campus better, you are welcome to join in.
about_statement: Our goal is not to lay everything out at once, but to make the next step easier. NYCU LIFE wants to be a quieter campus front door, so that students moving between transit, courses, and places never have to relearn the interface.
about_value_1_body: Move between buses, courses, and places without relearning the interface each time.
about_value_2_body: Know what to open, where to go, and what the next step is.
about_value_3_body: The story starts from real campus moments, not backend boundaries.
footer_tagline: A campus digital companion for students, clubs, and campus tools that still need a clearer home.
footer_rights: Maintained by the NYCU LIFE student team.
